display.purpose: Studio page titles and the Playlist title on an editor. 2.25rem / 600 / tracking-tight. Largest shipped role.

headline.purpose: Section titles and selected Playlist titles in the listener register at sm+.

title.purpose: Wordmark, small-viewport Playlist titles, empty-state headlines (those at 500).

body.purpose: Default copy, field values, table titles. 0.9375rem / 1.5.

small.purpose: Controls, transport track title, supporting row copy. 0.8125rem / 500.

label.purpose: Column heads, field labels, state words. Uppercase, 0.08em, wdth 88%, ink-3.

shelfmark.purpose: Filed code SS·XXX. Tabular, wdth 82%, 600, mood-ink. The identity type.

figure.purpose: Treatment for every quantity: tnum, 0.01em. Applied at any size.

shadows.name: inset-hairline
shadows.purpose: Outline controls and floating overlays. A drawn edge, not elevation.

shadows.name: inset-hairline-resting
shadows.purpose: Disabled solid control, so the label stays readable on bg-raised.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and background on controls and fields.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Register row ground change on hover.

motion.name: tick-in
motion.purpose: Figure digits stepping to a new value (translateY -0.42em, fade).

motion.name: level
motion.purpose: Playing indicator bars, scaleY 0.3↔1, origin bottom.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: collapse animation and transition duration.

components.name: Ghost Control
components.description: Default control: transparent, ink-2, 32px × 2px radius. Hover washes bg-raised.
components.css: .ds-control { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--ink-2)); font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-control:hover:not(:disabled) { color: hsl(var(--ink)); background: hsl(var(--bg-raised)); } .ds-control:disabled { color: hsl(var(--ink-3)); opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--mood-h) var(--mood-s-mark) var(--mood-l-mark)); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 1px; }

components.name: Solid Control
components.description: The one filled action. Ink on ground — mood never paints a CTA.

components.name: Outline Control
components.description: Ghost plus inset strong-rule hairline. Retry and secondary commits.

components.description: 32×32 ghost. Transport skips, theme, row actions. Danger tints only on hover.

components.name: Ruled Field
components.description: A baseline the value sits on. No box, no radius. Focus turns the rule to mood.

components.name: Shelfmark
components.description: Identity device: 3px mood tab plus SS·XXX in narrow tabular mood-ink.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A state word with a 6px dot. Active is ink; muted is rule-strong. Colour never carries the state alone.

components.name: Studio Nav
components.description: Sidebar items. Active is ink at 500 with a shelf tab; inactive is ink-2 with a 3px spacer.
components.html: TunesPlaylists

narrative.overview:
SoundShelf is a catalogue, not a listening room and not a cover-art grid. A Playlist is a filed holding: it is recognised by a three-character shelfmark, a 3px hue tab on the same baseline, and the figures that say what it holds and how long it runs. The product stores no artwork, so those three marks *are* the identity.

The surface is built from three materials only — a cool achromatic ground, a 1px hairline, and Archivo at two widths. Colour enters as one deterministic hue per Playlist, split into a text-safe ink and a fill mark, retuned per theme so the same angle holds on white and on near-black. Light and dark are both first-class; neither is a skin on the other. There are no cards, no panels, no boxes, and no shadows that carry rank. Grouping is a rule and the space around it. The listener reads an ordered register and plays it in the curator's order; the transport is a fixed register at the foot, not a floating player.
keyCharacteristics: Cool 240° achromatic ground and ink; light and dark as equal themes
One Playlist hue, inherited as `--mood-h` only; sat/lightness are theme parameters
Archivo with `wdth`: labels at 88%, shelfmarks at 82%; tabular figures on every quantity
1px hairlines (`--rule` / `--rule-strong`); 2px radii on controls; fields have none
Fixed rem type (ratio ~1.2); no fluid headings
Full-width register rows; transport is a ruled foot, never a card

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Colour on the surface is the current Playlist's mood, or danger. Nothing else is coloured. A screen with a second accent has left the system.

rules.name: The Tab-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every mood hue ships two treatments: `mood-ink` for type, `mood` for marks and fills. Never use the fill recipe on text, and never use the ink recipe as a large fill.

rules.name: The Neutral Action Rule
rules.body: A filled call to action is ink on ground (or ground on ink). Mood may mark identity, the current row, focus, and the scrub fill — it does not paint a button.

rules.name: The Two-Width Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries every role. Hire the `wdth` axis (88% labels, 82% shelfmarks) instead of a second family or a mono face.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Every quantity is tabular. A changing value must not shift its neighbours. Positions are zero-padded to two digits; clocks are `m:ss` or `h:mm:ss`.

rules.name: The Register Rule
rules.body: Grouping is a hairline and the space around it. Do not wrap a group in a surface. Selecting a Playlist opens its tracks *in place* — the shelf does not navigate away.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Depth is a 1px rule or an inset 1px hairline. A drop shadow, blur, or ambient glow is out of system. An inset hairline is a border, not elevation.

rules.name: The 2px Rule
rules.body: Radii stay at 2px on controls. Fields stay 0. Do not introduce 8px, 12px, or "card" rounding. Circles are reserved for actual dots.

dos: Do file every Playlist under a shelfmark, a 3px hue tab, and right-aligned figures on one baseline.
Do inherit only `--mood-h` and let the theme supply sat/lightness (ink vs mark).
Do set every quantity in `.figure` (`tnum`, 0.01em) and every column head in `.label`.
Do divide groups with a 1px `--rule` and space; use an inset 1px hairline for overlays and outline controls.
Do keep control radii at 2px and field radii at 0.
Do fill the primary action with `ink`, not `mood`.
Do name playback state in type ("PLAYING") as well as with the level bars.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by collapsing motion to `0.001ms`.
donts: Don't lay holdings out as a cover-art grid, tile gallery, or thumbnail list.
Don't float a player card, glass panel, or boxed chrome over the register.
Don't wrap a form, table, or empty state in a card, panel, or filled container.
Don't use a drop shadow, blur, or ambient glow; the inset hairline is the only permitted `box-shadow`.
Don't introduce a second type family, a mono face, or fluid/clamp headings.
Don't paint a button, badge, or progress *container* in the mood hue — tab, scrub fill, focus ring, and text-safe ink only.
Don't show a column of red destructive icons at rest; danger reads on approach.
Don't use colour alone to mean playing, public, error, or selected.
Don't draw a dashed drop-zone or any other box around a file input.
